title: One unit cancellation for a finite free complex over a scheme stalk
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], y a point, S=Spec(O_{Y,y}), and t:Spec(kappa(y))->S its residue morphism. Let P be a cochain complex [def-pc-derived-category] of O_S-modules supported in degrees 0 through d, and let n:Z->N be specified sizes with P^j isomorphic to the free sheaf on ULift(Fin(n(j))) [def-weil-pbc-free-module] for every j. Suppose at least one differential of the termwise residue pullback t^*P [def-pc-derived-pullback] is nonzero. Then there are a cochain complex P\', sizes n\':Z->N and a natural number i<d such that P is homotopy equivalent to P\', P\' has the same support bounds, P\'^j is free of size n\'(j), n\'(i)+1=n(i), n\'(i+1)+1=n(i+1), and n\'(j)=n(j) for j distinct from i and i+1. The conclusion is one cancellation and does not assert that P\' has zero residue differentials.

source.place: Tag 00MT (lemma-add-trivial-complex), one unit-entry cancellation; blueprint lem-pc-perfect-locus proof step 4. Source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00MT

proof.text: Unpack the negation of all residue differentials vanishing to obtain Q.d a b nonzero. HomologicalComplex.shape forces a+1=b. A zero original differential would have zero pullback by Functor.map_zero, so P.d a b is nonzero. The lower support bound and CochainComplex.isZero_of_isStrictlyGE rule out a<0 by IsZero.eq_of_src; the upper bound and isZero_of_isStrictlyLE rule out b>d by IsZero.eq_of_tgt. Write a as a natural number i and deduce i<d. All these statements are Mathlib lemmas and integer arithmetic.

Apply [lem-pc-finite-free-stalk-unit-cancellation-at] to the specified nonzero degree i to i+1. Unpack its complementary complex and ranks and insert the already proved i<d to assemble all clauses of the unchanged statement.

theorem exists_stalk_unit_cancellation {Y : Scheme.{u}} (y : Y)
    (P : CochainComplex (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d) (n : ℤ → ℕ)
    (hfree : ∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty
      (P.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
        (R := (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n j)))))
    (hbad : ¬ ∀ a b : ℤ,
      (((Modules.pullback (Spec.map (Y.residue y))).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
        P).d a b = 0) :
    ∃ (P' : CochainComplex (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).Modules ℤ)
      (n' : ℤ → ℕ) (i : ℕ),
      i < d ∧ Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv P P') ∧
      P'.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ P'.IsStrictlyLE d ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty
        (P'.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n' j))))) ∧
      n' (i : ℤ) + 1 = n (i : ℤ) ∧
      n' ((i : ℤ) + 1) + 1 = n ((i : ℤ) + 1) ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ (i : ℤ) → j ≠ (i : ℤ) + 1 → n' j = n j)
